description: Procure-to-pay across the PO header (EKKO), items (EKPO) and PO history (EKBE). A best-effort starter — confirm table/column names against your SAP export and add Z-table steps via the override layer before mining.

required_tables.name: EKKO
required_tables.description: Purchasing document header (one row per PO)

notes: Field-level change events (status transitions, release steps) come from CDHDR/CDPOS — use the SAP connector's change-document mode for those. AEDAT/EINDT/BUDAT are SAP date fields (YYYYMMDD); ensure they parse to dates on export.
